messages:
maria_cs: FYI — Spectra Health (pilot) just pinged asking for a short-lived config change for an APAC demo this Friday.
maria_cs: Customer wants: APAC region enablement, add three CIDRs to allowlist, and a temporary increase to their API rate window for 72h. They emphasized this is a funded pilot (renewal signal).
liam_re: can you paste the CIDRs + their account id? also do they need dedicated capacity or just hosted with edge routing? @ops_tzu @ben_eng FYI
maria_cs: account: acct_spectra_0042
maria_cs: CIDRs from customer (copied): 203.45.120.0/22, 13.250.64.0/18, 45.120.200.128/25
maria_cs: They said "APAC pilot traffic will be light but bursty — want 4x rate window for 72 hours starting Fri 09:00 SGT (UTC+8)." :white_check_mark:
ops_tzu: thanks — quick questions: do they need egress peering for APAC edge (private peering) or is IP allowlist enough? Also confirm whether they want region tag added so traffic routes to apac-edge nodes.
maria_cs: customer prefers IP allowlist only for now, no peering. They do want the account tagged for apac-edge routing so model selection chooses nearest edge.
ben_eng: APAC edge needs a short provisioning step if not already enabled. I can flip the region flag and patch the allowlist. We should also increase the per-key rate_window from 60 -> 240 req/min for 72h — that matches their "4x" ask.
liam_re: fine. please include audit note referencing the renewal pilot and set an automatic rollback after 72h. capture in ticketing.
ops_tzu: plan:
- add account tag: `region:apac-edge` on acct_spectra_0042
- add allowlist entries: `203.45.120.0/22`, `13.250.64.0/18`, `45.120.200.128/25`
- bump `rate_window_per_key` 60 -> 240 for 72h starting Fri 2024-11-29T01:00:00Z (09:00 SGT)
- enable verbose request logging for the window and route logs to cs-logs/spectra-pilot

ops_tzu: internal CLI to apply (will run after thumbs up):
```
# example
redwoodctl accounts patch acct_spectra_0042 \
  --set tags.region=apac-edge \
  --add allowlist=203.45.120.0/22 \
  --add allowlist=13.250.64.0/18 \
  --add allowlist=45.120.200.128/25 && \
redwoodctl rate-config update --account acct_spectra_0042 --key default --window 240 --ttl 72h
```
ben_eng: quick note — backend models are available in EU and hosted APAC edge pool but cold-starts can add latency; we'll enable prefix caching and KV cache warmup for their main routes to reduce tail latency during the demo.
maria_cs: customer confirmed times and gave permission to proceed. they asked we keep them updated in this channel and email ops@spectra-health.com with the config ticket id.
liam_re: go ahead with ops plan once applied post-approval. @ops_tzu please create ticket in ENG-OPS and add rollback timer.
ops_tzu: applying change now. creating ticket ENGOPS-5879. audit note: "Spectra Health pilot: apac-edge tag + allowlist + 72h rate bump; rollback scheduled + logs enabled; renewal interest flagged." Will paste job id when done.
deploy_bot: configuration change queued: job_id=job_2024_ENGOPS_5879
ops_tzu: done — changes applied and rollout completed.
ops_tzu: job_id=job_2024_ENGOPS_5879, audit_log=https://internal.redwood/audit/job_2024_ENGOPS_5879, rollback_at=2024-12-02T01:00:00Z
ben_eng: monitoring hooks added — will report latency and error-rate every 30m during window. if p95 > 600ms I'll throttle back and notify.
maria_cs: perfect — I'm scheduling a post-pilot enablement call next Monday to capture feedback and tie into renewal motion. :calendar:
liam_re: noted renewal signal. tagging sales/AM to prioritize follow-up. thanks team!
maria_cs: thanks everyone :heart: Spectra asked us to confirm by email as well, I'll cc ops@spectra-health.com with ENGOPS-5879 and the audit link.
